tools.purpose: X local archive analysis and guarded live sync/actions.
tools.freshness: Refresh the relevant archive unless the user requests no refresh or asks only about setup.
tools.safety: Never inspect credential files; require exact intent for remote actions and protect private DMs.

tools.purpose: Discord archive sync/search and supported explicit writes.
tools.freshness: Run a full sync before answering from message data and again after supported writes. Use a full-cache wiretap scan for locally cached direct messages.
tools.safety: Do not expose tokens or private message content beyond the request; never combine distinct account profiles.

tools.purpose: Instagram Direct/profile reads and explicit messaging actions.
tools.freshness: Use thread IDs from a fresh bounded inbox result.
tools.safety: Never inspect sessions; no website fallback; login stays user-owned.

tools.purpose: Notion local archive sync, search, SQL, export, and guarded private share.
tools.freshness: Check archive status and explicitly select the sync source when freshness matters.
tools.safety: Never expose tokens, signed URLs, cache databases, or private archive contents.

tools.purpose: Local Wispr Flow and Apple Notes reads, explicit exports, guarded Apple changes, and one-way mirroring.
tools.freshness: Use doctor against current local provider state; Wispr reads do not need a sync.
tools.safety: Wispr access is read-only. Apple writes require stable IDs, exact intent, and --apply --yes. Body edits must preserve retrieved raw rich content, pass the existing title explicitly, and be read back for verification; mirrors are one-way and never delete Notes.

tools.purpose: Notion API reads and explicit page creation/append.
tools.freshness: Run an auth status check before authenticated work.
tools.safety: Never print injected environment values; writes require target and content.

tools.purpose: Obsidian vault search, links, reads, and explicit note edits.
tools.freshness: Use the configured vault as the source of truth.
tools.safety: Treat the vault read-only unless a specific edit is requested.

tools.purpose: Screen video recording, event logs, upload, sharing, and edits.
tools.freshness: Check recording status before starting a recording.
tools.safety: Record only on request; sharing, deletion, trim, and rename require exact targets.

tools.purpose: Browser-backed website adapters and Browser Bridge automation.
tools.freshness: Run doctor before browser-backed work and list profiles when profile choice matters.
tools.safety: Never inspect cookies or session storage; browser/account writes require exact intent.

tools.purpose: macOS screen, app, window inspection and UI automation support.
tools.freshness: Inspect the current visible UI state immediately before acting.
tools.safety: Prefer read-only inspection; UI writes need a clear target and task authority.

tools.purpose: Reddit browsing, search, exports, account reads, and explicit interactions.
tools.freshness: Use bounded sequential requests and structured output.
tools.safety: Never inspect browser cookies; interactions require exact target/action.

tools.purpose: Apple Reminders reads and explicit create/update/complete/delete actions.
tools.freshness: Verify Today/subtask views against native state when CLI output may lag.

tools.purpose: Spotify search, playback, queue, library, playlists, and listening data.
tools.freshness: Check auth status before authenticated work.
tools.safety: Never inspect cookies; playback and account/player changes are user-visible writes.

tools.purpose: Live X timelines, search, bookmarks, profiles, and guarded account actions.
tools.freshness: Use for current state; prefer local Birdclaw archives for historical analysis.
tools.safety: Avoid verbose auth output; require exact target/content for writes.

tools.purpose: WhatsApp linked-device live reads and writes.
tools.freshness: Use current linked-device state for live tasks.
tools.safety: Sends and account/group mutations require exact target and content/action.

tools.freshness: Sync before answers from archive data unless the user opts out.
tools.safety: Never mutate WhatsApp or expose raw archives/private message text unnecessarily.

tools.purpose: Authenticated X API transport and guarded live actions.
tools.freshness: Check auth status before live API work.
tools.safety: Never inspect credential storage or use verbose auth; no inline secrets.

tools.purpose: Public-media metadata/subtitles and explicitly authorized bounded downloads.
tools.freshness: Inspect public metadata only when requested; no background or bulk retrieval.
tools.safety: No cookies, login, proxy, geo-bypass, or unauthorized downloads.
